title: Adding two decimals with three places, and what a carry means
description: The sum of 75.345 and 86.691 is found place by place, with a carry from every place, and each carry is explained. Keeko doubts the result and thinks the sum is 161.036.
teaching_notes: One idea: a carry is ten of a place made into one of the next place. Watch for students who skip the carry from the tenths.

source: Add 75.345 and 86.691 in the compact form, and say what each
video_script.why: The child has added two decimals with one carry and now meets a sum with a carry in every place.
video_script.substitution: Add from the right place by place, and carry ten of a place as one of the next place.
video_script.anchor: Two decimals, 75.345 and 86.691, one above the other in a place table with a carry row above it.
video_script.wrong_answer: one hundred and sixty one point zero three six
video_script.wrong_move: Forgets the carry from the tenths and writes 161.036.
video_script.payoff_line: Line up the point, add from the right, and carry tens

final_answer.spoken: one hundred and sixty two point zero three six

maths_rules: hundredths: 4 + 9 = 13, write 3, carry 1 to the tenths
tenths: 3 + 6 + 1 = 10, write 0, carry 1 to the units
units: 5 + 6 + 1 = 12, write 2, carry 1 to the tens
tens: 7 + 8 + 1 = 16, write 6, carry 1 to the hundreds
video_script.design: The place table keeps its columns all video. Each carry is a small coloured one that travels up to the next column.

beats.on_screen: title card From your book; 75.345 above 86.691 in a place table

marks.ask: the two decimals appear one above the other
marks.carry: a carry row appears above the table

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book about adding decimals.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Add seventy five point three four five and eighty six point six nine one.
<bookmark mark='carry'/>Then say what each carry means.

beats.on_screen: the two decimals stay on the board
narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: like places add together; ten of a place make one of the next place

marks.like: the place table lines up on the point
marks.ten: an arrow runs from one column to the next column on the left

narration: <bookmark mark='like'/>We add decimals place by place, with one point exactly above the other.
<bookmark mark='ten'/>Ten of a place make one of the next place to the left.
<bookmark mark='given'/>Given, seventy five point three four five and eighty six point six nine one.

beats.on_screen: To find: 75.345 + 86.691, and what each carry means
narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the sum, and say what each carry means.

beats.on_screen: thousandths: 5 + 1 = 6; hundredths: 4 + 9 = 13, write 3, carry 1 to the tenths

marks.hu: the one moves up to the tenths column

narration: <bookmark mark='th'/>Step one, add from the right. Thousandths: five plus one is six.
<bookmark mark='hu'/>Hundredths: four plus nine is thirteen. Write three and carry one to the tenths.

beats.on_screen: tenths: 3 + 6 + 1 = 10, write 0, carry 1; units: 5 + 6 + 1 = 12, write 2, carry 1

marks.te: the tenths column is boxed and the one moves up
marks.un: the units column is boxed and the one moves up

narration: <bookmark mark='te'/>Step two, tenths: three plus six plus the carried one is ten. Write zero and carry one to the units.
<bookmark mark='un'/>Units: five plus six plus one is twelve. Write two and carry one to the tens.

marks.tn: the tens column is boxed and the one moves up
marks.hd: the hundreds column gets the one

narration: <bookmark mark='tn'/>Step three, tens: seven plus eight plus one is sixteen. Write six and carry one to the hundreds.
<bookmark mark='hd'/>Hundreds: only the carried one is there, so write one.

beats.on_screen: 13 hundredths = 1 tenth + 3 hundredths; each carry is ten of a place made into one of the next

marks.m1: thirteen hundredths is split into one tenth and three hundredths
marks.m2: each carry is circled with ten blocks becoming one block

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step four, what does a carry mean? Thirteen hundredths is one tenth and three hundredths.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The carried one is that tenth, moved to the tenths place. Every carry is ten of a place made into one of the next.

marks.val: the digits of the sum are read along the table

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Line up the point, add from the right, and carry tens.
<bookmark mark='val'/>The sum is one hundred and sixty two point zero three six.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the place table
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: a speech bubble: 161.036 when the tenths carry is skipped; the tenths total is 10; the bubble is crossed out

marks.fix: ten tenths are regrouped into one unit

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the sum is one hundred and sixty one point zero three six. The tenths carry can be skipped.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>But the tenths total is ten, and ten tenths make one unit.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>A forgotten carry makes the sum too small.
